formattedAddress: 4823 SE Woodstock Blvd, Portland, OR 97206, USA

editorialSummary.text: Family-run café serving Oaxacan-style breakfasts, pan dulce, and horchata lattes in a sunny corner spot.

text.text: The chilaquiles verdes are the best I've had outside my abuela's kitchen. Doña Rosa remembers everyone's order and the horchata latte is dangerously good. This place deserves way more attention.
Hidden gem on Woodstock. Concha french toast on weekends only — set an alarm, they sell out by 10. Cash and card both fine. Wish they had a website so I could check the specials before biking over.
Wonderful tamales and the cafe de olla smells like cinnamon heaven. Gets crowded on weekends and there's often a wait — they could really use online ordering for pickup.
Como en casa. El pan dulce se hace ahí mismo cada mañana y se nota. Los dueños son amabilísimos. Síganlos en Instagram @lavecinapdx para ver cuando sale el pan.
My Saturday ritual. Breakfast burrito with their smoky salsa roja, coffee, sunshine at the window counter. Family owned and it shows in every detail.

Food is genuinely great but showed up Monday and they were closed — nothing online said so. Hours on the door didn't match what Google showed either. Get it together on the info front, the cooking is 5 stars.
Ordered a tres leches for my mom's birthday by calling — worth every penny. They do custom cakes but you'd never know it, nothing is posted anywhere. Tell your friends.
The kind of neighborhood spot that makes a neighborhood. Kids' hot chocolate comes with a little concha bunny. Perfection.
